start_filters: Never starts at ayah 1 or 2 of any surah, including Juz Amma.
similarity_filter: No high lexical similarity within a model; sequence ratio and six-word fingerprints are rejected.
distribution: For each cumulative range [top_juz..30], the top Juz has 4 questions and every lower Juz has 3 basic questions.
source: Tanzil Quran text via Quran JSON (uthmani), Hafs scripts; standard page numbers from Quran.com verse metadata.
